scripts.build: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp -R index.html css js assets favicon.ico profilepic.jpeg cpp-tracer.js www/
scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.open:android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.build:apk: npm run sync && cd android && JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" ./gradlew assembleDebug && cd .. && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ThinkCode-debug.apk
scripts.build:release: npm run sync && cd android && JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" ./gradlew assembleRelease && cd .. && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ThinkCode-release.apk
